summary: The code is syntactically valid and imports resolve, but the simulation is incomplete and will fail at runtime because Simulation.run() is missing. Initialization is unfinished (states, network, and market not fully set), there is no daily time loop, and no evaluation implementation. While error handling exists for data loading and top-level execution, the core functionality required by the task is not implemented.

issues.description: Missing Simulation.run() method leads to immediate runtime failure when main() calls sim.run().
issues.location: main() call to sim.run(); Simulation class (no run method defined)
issues.solution: Implement Simulation.run() with a daily loop from day 0 through sim_end_day handling policy/media signals, exposure computation, information diffusion, retail market updates, and mask adoption decisions, and record daily outputs.

issues.description: Simulation.initialize() is incomplete. It does not finish setting up state arrays (is_mask_wearing, received_info, risk_perception, budgets, inventory, trust, compliance), does not build neighbors from network_json, does not precompute neighbor indices, and does not instantiate RetailMarket with population size.
issues.location: Simulation.initialize (ends abruptly after setting a few Person attributes)
issues.solution: Complete initialize(): derive initial states from train_df (day 0) when available; build neighbors via NetworkManager.build_neighbors; if network data missing, generate a fallback small-world network; precompute neighbor index arrays; allocate numpy arrays for all agent states; instantiate RetailMarket with population size.

issues.description: Missing Simulation.evaluate() method to compute required metrics (RMSE, MAE, etc.) comparing simulated adoption to observed series.
issues.solution: Implement evaluate(): aggregate simulated adoption time series; compare to observed aggregation from train_data.csv over calibration period (days 0-29) and validation (days 30-39); compute RMSE, MAE, peak adoption, time to 50%, final adoption, subgroup Gini as specified; return metrics dict.

issues.description: No daily simulation loop to model information propagation and behavioral changes (policy from Day 10).
issues.solution: In run(): for each day, call PolicyAndMedia.step(day), ExposureCalculator.compute(...), InformationDiffusion.step(...), RetailMarket.step(...), MaskAdoptionDecision.step(...), update states, and log with AdoptionAggregator.

issues.description: Network is not constructed when social_network.json is missing; no fallback generation used.
issues.solution: If use_empirical_network is True and loaded network_json is empty, call _generate_small_world_network(N) and then NetworkManager.build_neighbors on the result; otherwise proceed with provided network.

issues.description: ExposureCalculator returns weighted peer_mask_fraction values that can exceed 1 after applying weights and mobility, which may overly inflate logistic inputs in MaskAdoptionDecision.
issues.solution: Clip peer_mask_fraction per layer to [0, 1] after weighting, or rescale coefficients in MaskAdoptionDecision accordingly.

issues.description: Evaluation should use true simulated adoption, not noisy observed values, to compute RMSE/MAE against empirical data.
issues.location: AdoptionAggregator.aggregate (adoption_rate_obs vs adoption_rate_true) and missing evaluate()
issues.solution: In evaluate(), use adoption_rate_true time series for metric calculations; keep adoption_rate_obs for reporting/visualization only.

issues.description: Agent attributes defined do not fully align with the task specification (e.g., missing trust_in_authorities naming alignment, fatigue, habit, etc.), and some behaviors are placeholders only.
issues.solution: Map available attributes to spec (e.g., trust_in_authorities -> trust_in_institutions), and implement or stub consistent state updates for fatigue and habit if required by the modeling plan.
